title: cmd_and_ctrl / Growth
description: Growth and engagement, aggregate only: new and returning players, week-over-week retention, signup cohorts, games per player and game length, and how often a few features are used (ADR 0123 amendment, #3557).

list.name: env
list.label: env
list.description: Which environment's host and server to show.

panels.title: New players, last 7 days
panels.description: Accounts whose first finished game ended in the last 7 days. Read from the database every 5 minutes.

panels.title: Returning players, last 7 days
panels.description: Accounts that played in the last 7 days and had a finished game before them.

panels.title: Week-over-week retention
panels.description: Of the accounts that played in the 7 days before the last 7, the share that played in the last 7 as well.

panels.title: Games per active player, last 7 days
panels.description: Games with recorded statistics that ended in the last 7 days, divided by the signed-in accounts seated at them.

panels.title: New and returning players
panels.description: Accounts that played in the trailing 7 days, split by whether their first finished game was inside that window. Each point is that moment's trailing 7 days.

panels.title: Week-over-week retention
panels.description: Of the accounts that played in the 7 days before the last 7, the share that played in the last 7 as well.

panels.title: Signup cohorts still playing
panels.description: Accounts created 1, 4 and 8 weeks ago (a 7-day band each: 1w is 14 to 7 days ago), and the share of each that played in the last 7 days. Small cohorts swing a lot: see the next panel for their size.

panels.title: Signup cohort sizes
panels.description: Accounts created in each cohort's 7-day band, and how many of them played in the last 7 days.

panels.title: Games per active player, last 7 days
panels.description: Games with recorded statistics that ended in the trailing 7 days, divided by the signed-in accounts seated at them.

panels.title: Seats per finished game, last 7 days
panels.description: Seats (people and bots) per finished game over the trailing 7 days. A full commander table is 4.

panels.title: Game length, last 7 days
panels.description: Turns and rounds per finished game over the trailing 7 days, from the recorded game statistics.

panels.title: Players per week
panels.description: The trailing-7-day count of new and returning players, sampled once a week over the last 12 weeks.

panels.title: Retention per week
panels.description: Week-over-week retention, sampled once a week over the last 12 weeks.

panels.title: New accounts per week
panels.description: Accounts created per week (first sign-ins), over the last 12 weeks.

panels.title: Games ended per week
panels.description: Tables that ended per week, over the last 12 weeks.

panels.title: Practice and real tables started, per day
panels.description: Tables that left the lobby, by kind. Practice tables are one person against bots and are not in the game counters.

panels.title: Rematches offered, per day
panels.description: Rematches offered at a finished table, against the tables created that day.

panels.title: Statistics page loads, per day
panels.description: Times GET /me/stats was answered: how often the statistics page is opened.

panels.title: Own-key AI seats added, per day
panels.description: Bot seats added that run on their owner's own model key.

panels.title: Own-key fallbacks, per day, by reason
panels.description: Own-key bot seats that stopped using their model key and played the built-in heuristic, by reason (refused, quota, model, unreadable, private, unreachable, daily_limit, call_limit, removed, other).

options.content:
CMD & CTRL does not track clicks on a card's shop link, by design (ADR 0179 and the Privacy notice), so there is no click series on this dashboard. Counts of those clicks come from the retailer's own reports.

Every number here is an aggregate count over accounts or games. No series carries a person, a name or a game id; to see the accounts behind a number, use the **Open in cmd_and_ctrl** link on a panel.
